description: Savings-gated parameterized tree macros over parsed templates with LZMA backend.
basis: Same reversible archive format as blue_dolphin_tree_macro_v1, but a template shape is admitted only when estimated raw encoded bytes beat the literal template bytes by at least the safety margin.
verdict: Savings gate improves the frequency-only macro archive but still loses to raw baseline_lzma at 1MB and 10MB; parsed-template macro rewriting is retired for the LZMA-backed lane.
